user.title: Before you start
user.description: Before continuing, please confirm that you have deleted any old entries that were added via the 'seplos_bms_ha' addon. Leaving old entries may cause sensor naming conflicts with the new version. Any data stored in the old sensors should be adopted by the new addon automatically.

data.confirm: I have removed the old seplos_bms_ha entries

bms_type.title: BMS version
bms_type.description: Select your BMS version. If yours is not listed it is not supported yet.

connection_type.title: Connection type
connection_type.description: Choose how the BMS is connected: a local USB-RS485 adapter, or an RS485-to-Ethernet bridge over Telnet.

usb_config.title: Serial connection
usb_config.description: Serial device for the USB-RS485 adapter, and the link speed (Seplos V2 is normally 19200).

telnet_config.title: Telnet bridge
telnet_config.description: Host and TCP port of the RS485-to-Ethernet bridge (Waveshare, Elfin, etc.) in transparent mode.

sensor_prefix.title: Battery and naming
sensor_prefix.description: Battery address (DIP) and the prefix used for every entity name.

error.unique_id_conflict: Another entry already uses this battery address and connection.

init.title: Update BMS settings
init.description: Change the connection, battery address, naming or polling without deleting the entry.

error.unique_id_conflict: Another entry already uses this battery address and connection.
